column1: # The outcome registry, transcribed by hand from the outcome specification's
# tables (metadata results, proposer outcomes, append outcomes, resolve
# answers, read stops), never generated from outcome.h.
# effect: a success is happened; "definite refusal" and a definite metadata
# refusal are refused; "indefinite" is indefinite; resolve answers and read
# final: every metadata, proposer and append outcome is yes; a resolve
# answer's "Final" and a read stop's "Terminal" column otherwise.
# retry: "-" none, "no" never, "yes" later, "after re-read" after_reread,
# "after a seal or delete" after_seal_or_delete, "after retention"
# after_retention, "after resend" after_resend, "resend on the successor"
# and a sealed range's successors on_successor, "resolve, then the
# resolve, "resolve after the seal" resolve_after_seal, "reopen at start"
# reopen_at_start, "reopen at to" reopen_past_lost, "the caller may reopen"
# reopen; a terminal read stop with no note is never, a cancelled one none.
# payload: the "Carries" column; braces in a name are its payload.
